verdict.rationale: Foreloop provides an embeddable feedback widget that end users open on your site to describe a problem and submit it (foreloop-docs-9). It installs with a single script tag and a widget key, with nothing to build and no redeploys needed for updates (foreloop-docs-29, foreloop-docs-18, foreloop-docs-12). Routing submissions to a project is set on a settings page, and spam is filtered (foreloop-docs-11, foreloop-docs-20). However, this is an in-page widget, not a standalone public-facing portal, and adding the tag still means editing site code, which a PM may not be able to do alone. missing for 10: a hosted public feedback portal or board, evidence of a no-code setup path that needs no site code change, and independent hands-on corroboration.
